history.summary: Compact 4BR (1141sqft) at Ecopolitan, a 2016 99yr privatised EC in Punggol D19, at $1.78M / $1,560 PSF — a high PSF for a Punggol EC and a small footprint for a 4-bed. Liquid ticket but no URA data and a middling score (523); unremarkable.
history.rating_rationale: $1,560 PSF is on the higher side for a 2016 Punggol EC, and 1141sqft is tight for a genuine 4BR (per-room squeeze). $1.78M sits in the liquid band but at the top of where Punggol EC buyers transact. No URA appreciation/median data (regional prior only). Score 523 / Elo 1207 with a losing 236-180 record. Soo Teck LRT 630m is the only transit. PDD + CRL are real but broadly-priced D19 catalysts.
red_flags: $1,560 PSF rich for a Punggol EC
